<objective>
Harden the qr-menu production build: switch Vite `build.sourcemap` from `true` to `'hidden'` (QRM-11) so `.map` files are emitted for error-monitoring tools but no inline `//# sourceMappingURL=` comment ships to browsers, and extend the existing `bundle-no-dev-leak.spec.ts` to assert this (QRM-12). Also add the `noindex` robots meta to `index.html` (D-06) so table-session URLs are never indexed.

Scope boundary (apps/CLAUDE.md): the `apps/CLAUDE.md` "Source maps + production hygiene" HARD rule requires customer-facing apps to strip `.map` from the deploy artifact and upload via Sentry, plus a CDN-layer CSP and `*.map` block. Phase 6 has NO production deploy (that is Phase 7.5). Phase 6 deliberately does NOT strip `.map` — hidden maps must remain in dist so the future Sentry upload has them. The artifact-strip + Sentry upload + CDN `*.map` block + CSP are tracked as REQUIRED Phase 7.5 PLAN tasks (see `deferred_to_phase_7_5` frontmatter and threat T-06-11). Phase 6 owns only `sourcemap:'hidden'` + the bundle test; the residual ".map present in dist" risk is explicitly owned by 7.5.

Purpose: Public-surface build hygiene at the build layer. The bundle test is the QRM-12 mitigation. This runs last so it validates the fully built-out qr-menu (plans 03/04) bundle.
Output: Hidden source maps, a passing bundle assertion, a noindexed SPA shell, and a concretely-tracked 7.5 deferral for the deploy-time map hygiene.
</objective>
